notes: Gold triage conversations, set A (areas: water_leak, blocked_drain, electrics, windows_doors, appliances). Question ids, answer keys, cause ids and tenant_message texts come from the area KBs. tenant_facts holds the answer the tenant gives when first asked; for self_help_fails the KB's if_fails answers of the self-help cause override them after the failed tip, which yields expected_cause. Technician causes: concluding message, then the consent question (', floor and the photos' only when a photo was sent), then 'Thanks. Your property manager is confirming the repair, I'll update you shortly.' A re-ask after an off-topic reply repeats the same qid and does not count twice; 'clarify' does not count.

conversations.title: Burst pipe, water spreading across the kitchen

turns.text: HELP water is spreading all over the kitchen floor, I think a pipe burst

Please turn off the main water valve now (usually near the water meter, in the bathroom or kitchen), switch off the fuse for any wet sockets, and move valuables away. I've alerted your property manager and an emergency plumber is being arranged.
ok main valve is off now
Good. Keep away from wet sockets; I'll update you as soon as the plumber is confirmed.

must_not: ask any diagnostic question before the safety steps
ask where the water comes from
ask for consent before the safety message
promise an arrival time

conversations.title: Küchenspüle verstopft, Saugglocke hilft (deutsch)

turns.text: Hallo, das Spülbecken in der Küche läuft gar nicht mehr ab.
Okay. Hast du schon eine Saugglocke probiert oder Haare aus dem Abflusssieb gezogen?

Meist sind es Fett oder Essensreste im Siphon. Probier eine Saugglocke (den Überlauf mit einem nassen Tuch zuhalten) und gieß danach heißes Wasser nach, keine chemischen Reiniger. Sag mir, ob es wieder abläuft.
Hat geklappt, läuft wieder ab. Danke!
Schön. Melde dich jederzeit, wenn es wieder verstopft.
